info.title: CivicPulse AI API
info.description: Backend API for the CivicPulse AI civic intelligence platform.

post.description:
Register a new user account.  Always creates a citizen-role account.
Any role field in the request body is ignored; privileged roles
(admin, officer, worker) can only be assigned by an administrator
through a separate protected process.

post.summary: Login and obtain a JWT access token
post.description:
OAuth2 password flow. Submit `username` (email) and `password` as
form fields. Returns a bearer JWT and the authenticated user record.

The generic error message intentionally does not distinguish between
'unknown email' and 'wrong password' to prevent user enumeration.

get.description: List all issues. Officer and admin only.

schema.title: Response Get Issues Api Issues  Get

get.description: Return only issues reported by the calling user.

schema.title: Response Get My Issues Api Issues Mine Get

get.description:
Retrieve a single issue.
- Citizens: only their own issues.
- Officers, workers, admins: any issue.

patch.description:
Update an issue.
- Officers and admins: may update any field.
- Workers: may only update `status` on issues assigned to them.
- Citizens: not permitted.

schema.title: Response Get Agent Logs Api Agents Logs  Issue Id  Get

get.description:
Returns a structured pipeline summary for display in the dashboard.

Assembles data from agent_logs + approvals for the given issue.

schema.title: Response List Pending Approvals Api Approvals Pending Get

get.description:
Returns aggregate counts derived from the issues table.
All values reflect the live database state.
